_comment: SATORI-specific text used by scripts/shiori/satori/lib.ps1. UTF-8 on purpose: the .ps1 files are ASCII only, so the Japanese strings live here.
plainLines: ＄自動挿入ウェイトタイプ＝無効
flushMarkNote: Mc201-5 (built with VC6) prints the end-of-message mark of satori::endl as the digits 1057598 and never flushes it, so SATORI's [ERROR] messages reach tamac late, glued together by these digits. They are split apart again.

patterns.regex: ^SAORI読み込み中にエラーが発生
patterns.hint: a line of ＠SAORI in satori_conf.txt is wrong or its file is missing
a SAORI dll could not be loaded
a dictionary file could not be read
satori_conf.txt was not found, so ＊初期化 and ＠SAORI are not read

patterns.regex: ^\s*（(?:i, s, m, x が使えます|undefined subroutine .*|missing .*)） not found\.
patterns.hint: the text of a regex_ error message was expanded as a name; the cause is the regex_ call before it (see the 400 Bad Request error): an invalid pattern, a (?&name) that is not defined, or an option other than i, s, m, x
a call with arguments to a name that does not exist: a misspelled function, or a SAORI missing from ＠SAORI
no word group, sentence, variable or function has that name (a variable that was never set is reported too, and stays in the text as written)
the jump target sentence does not exist; SATORI goes on with the next line, which dictionaries often rely on
（） nested too deeply, usually a circular call
too many jumps, usually a loop
an expansion result is too long
check parentheses, operators and division by 0
the condition of a jump could not be calculated
a ＄ line needs a tab or ＝ between the name and the value
